description: On the yellow tabletop in the corner, there’s a gold slipcase standing upright with a couple of small paperback books nearby. The left hand rests on the table while the right hand picks up the gray book, rotates it upright, and slides it into the open side of the slipcase; then the right hand repeats this by lifting the red book and pushing it in beside the first, and finally inserts a green book to make a neat row before letting go.
